description: Winemakers and owners host pre-booked vineyard tours and in-depth tastings of the new release 2025 Pinot Noir over the King's Birthday Weekend. Four sessions across Sunday 7 June and Monday 8 June. A rare opportunity to see the property with the people who farm it and taste the 2025 vintage on its first weekend of release. Free for KBS Wine Club members.
priceRange: Free for KBS Wine Club members
weatherDependency: Outdoor walk through vineyard; dress warmly for June
nearbyAttractions: Stonier Pies & Pinot (same weekend); Winter Wine Festival
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with Friday/Saturday Winter Wine Festival then visit Stonier Sunday/Monday for the tour
